1  ORDER 06.08.2025 Heard Mr. S. Islam, learned counsel for the appellant.

This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is directed against the judgment and award dated 29.03.2025 passed by the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT), Goalpara, in MAC Case No.419/2022.

It is to be noted here that vide impugned judgment and award dated 29.03.2025, the learned Tribunal has directed the respondent No.1 herein to pay a sum of Rs.24,29,494/- being the compensation to the appellant herein with interest @7% per annum from the date of filing of the evidence on affidavit in the claim petition i.e. 15.02.2024 till payment.
Perused the memo of appeal and the grounds mentioned therein and also perused the impugned judgment and award dated 29.03.2025.
Issue notice to the respondents, returnable within 4(four) weeks.
Step be taken by registered post with A/D and also by usual process within a week from today.
Registry shall call for the record from the learned Tribunal.

Sd/- Robin Phukan JUDGE Comparing Assistant Moinuddin Sk @ Moinuddin Ali Sk @ ... vs The Divisional Manager And 2 Ors on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193578854/
